reason.zh: 任务要求穿过走廊尽头的拱门进入客厅，从左侧经过沙发和电视，再进入阳光房并左转；本段却进入一间有床、桌柜、电视和椅子的卧室，最后靠近窗前白色窗帘，未见客厅沙发或阳光房入口，因此发生了与任务要求冲突的通行。
reason.en: The task requires going through the open archway at the hallway's end into the living room, passing a sofa and TV on the left, then entering the sunroom and turning left; this segment instead enters a bedroom containing a bed, desk/cabinet, TV, and chair, and finally approaches white window curtains. No living-room sofa or sunroom doorway is seen, so this is movement that conflicts with the task requirements.

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Go through the open archway at the end of the hallway to enter the living room.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 穿过走廊尽头的敞开门洞进入客厅。

instruction_evidence.quote_en: passing a sofa and TV on your left
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 从左侧经过沙发和电视

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Enter the sunroom through this doorway, and turn left.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 从这个门口进入阳光房，然后左转。

description.zh: 在门口及进入后可见左侧墙上的电视和矮柜/书桌、前方的椅子和窗户、右侧的白色床铺，表明这是卧室而非客厅。
description.en: At the doorway and after entering, a wall-mounted TV and low cabinet/desk are visible on the left, a chair and window ahead, and a white bed on the right, indicating a bedroom rather than a living room.

description.zh: 视线继续靠近窗前，最后贴近白色窗帘，左下可见矮柜上的小盆栽；没有出现沙发、阳光房门口，也没有左转后停在客厅沙发前的证据。
description.en: The view continues toward the window and finally comes close to white curtains, with a small plant on the low cabinet at lower left; no sofa, sunroom doorway, or evidence of turning left and stopping in front of the living-room sofa appears.

uncertainties.zh: A点之前是否已沿正确走廊到达该门洞，以及该门洞是否就是任务中的走廊尽头拱门，无法仅凭本段确认。
uncertainties.en: Whether the robot had reached this doorway along the correct hallway before point A, and whether this doorway is the hallway-end archway in the task, cannot be confirmed from this segment alone.
